typedef struct Node {

int height(Node* N) {

int max(int a, int b) {
    return (a > b) ? a : b;

Node* newNode(int key) {
    Node* node = (Node*)malloc(sizeof(Node));
    node->key = key;
    node->left = node->right = NULL;
    node->height = 1;
    return node;

Node* rightRotate(Node* y) {
    Node* x = y->left;
    Node* T2 = x->right;
    x->right = y;
    y->left = T2;
    y->height = max(height(y->left), height(y->right)) + 1;
    x->height = max(height(x->left), height(x->right)) + 1;
    return x;
}
Node* leftRotate(Node* x) {
    Node* y = x->right;
    Node* T2 = y->left;
    y->left = x;
    x->right = T2;
    x->height = max(height(x->left), height(x->right)) + 1;
    y->height = max(height(y->left), height(y->right)) + 1;
    return y;
}

int getBalance(Node* N) {
    if (N == NULL) return 0;
    return height(N->left) - height(N->right);

Node* insert(Node* node, int key) {
    if (node == NULL)
        return newNode(key);
    if (key < node->key)
        node->left = insert(node->left, key);
    else if (key > node->key)
        node->right = insert(node->right, key);
    else
        return node;
    node->height = 1 + max(height(node->left), height(node->right));
    int balance = getBalance(node);
    if (balance > 1 && key < node->left->key) return rightRotate(node);
    if (balance < -1 && key > node->right->key) return leftRotate(node);
    if (balance > 1 && key > node->left->key) {
        node->left = leftRotate(node->left);
        return rightRotate(node);
    }
    if (balance < -1 && key < node->right->key) {
        node->right = rightRotate(node->right);
        return leftRotate(node);
    }
    return node;
}
Node* minValueNode(Node* node) {
    Node* current = node;
    while (current->left)
        current = current->left;
    return current;
}

S.No: 2 Exp. Name: Operation of B-Tree - Insertion, Deletion and Search Date: 2026-11-07
Aim:

Write a C program to construct a B-Tree of a given minimum degree. First, insert a list of keys into the B-Tree and print the inorder traversal after all insertions. Then, delete a given set of keys from the B-Tree and again print the inorder traversal. Finally, search for a specific key in the current B-Tree and print whether it is found or not.


Input Format:

  • The first line contains a single integer t, the minimum degree of the B-Tree.
  • The second line contains an integer n, representing the number of keys to be inserted.
  • The third line contains n space-separated integers — the keys to be inserted into the B-Tree.
  • The fourth line contains an integer d, the number of keys to delete.
  • The fifth line contains d space-separated integers — the keys to be deleted from the B-Tree.
  • The sixth line contains a single integer k — the key to be searched in the B-Tree.


Output Format:

  • The first line of output should display the inorder traversal of the B-Tree after all insertions, with each key separated by a space.
  • The second line should display the inorder traversal of the B-Tree after all deletions, with each key separated by a space.
  • The third line should print Found if the search key exists in the B-Tree. If the key is not present, print Not Found instead.



Note: Refer to the test cases for better understanding.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdbool.h>

typedef struct BTreeNode {
    int *keys;
    int t;
    struct BTreeNode **C;
    int n;
    bool leaf;
} BTreeNode;

// Create a new node
BTreeNode* createNode(int t, bool leaf) {
    BTreeNode* node = (BTreeNode*)malloc(sizeof(BTreeNode));
    node->t = t;
    node->leaf = leaf;
    node->keys = (int*)malloc((2 * t - 1) * sizeof(int));
    node->C = (BTreeNode**)malloc((2 * t) * sizeof(BTreeNode*));
    node->n = 0;
    return node;
}

// Inorder traversal (no trailing dot)
void inorder(BTreeNode* root) {
    if (!root) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < root->n; i++) {
        if (!root->leaf)
            inorder(root->C[i]);
        printf("%d ", root->keys[i]);
    }
    if (!root->leaf)
        inorder(root->C[root->n]);
}

// Search a key
bool search(BTreeNode* root, int k) {
    int i = 0;
    while (i < root->n && k > root->keys[i])
        i++;
    if (i < root->n && root->keys[i] == k)
        return true;
    if (root->leaf)
        return false;

// Split full child
void splitChild(BTreeNode* x, int i) {
    int t = x->t;
    BTreeNode* y = x->C[i];
    BTreeNode* z = createNode(t, y->leaf);
    z->n = t - 1;
    for (int j = 0; j < t - 1; j++)
        z->keys[j] = y->keys[j + t];
    if (!y->leaf) {
        for (int j = 0; j < t; j++)
            z->C[j] = y->C[j + t];
    }
    y->n = t - 1;
    for (int j = x->n; j >= i + 1; j--)
        x->C[j + 1] = x->C[j];
    x->C[i + 1] = z;
    for (int j = x->n - 1; j >= i; j--)
        x->keys[j + 1] = x->keys[j];
    x->keys[i] = y->keys[t - 1];
    x->n++;
}

// Insert into non-full node
void insertNonFull(BTreeNode* x, int k) {
    int i = x->n - 1;
    if (x->leaf) {
        while (i >= 0 && k < x->keys[i]) {
            x->keys[i + 1] = x->keys[i];
            i--;
        }
        x->keys[i + 1] = k;
        x->n++;

        while (i >= 0 && k < x->keys[i])
            i--;

        if (x->C[i]->n == 2 * x->t - 1) {
            splitChild(x, i);
            if (k > x->keys[i])
                i++;
        }
        insertNonFull(x->C[i], k);
    }

// Insert key into tree
void insert(BTreeNode** rootRef, int k) {
    BTreeNode* r = *rootRef;
    if (r->n == 2 * r->t - 1) {
        BTreeNode* s = createNode(r->t, false);
        s->C[0] = r;
        splitChild(s, 0);
        int i = (k > s->keys[0]) ? 1 : 0;
        insertNonFull(s->C[i], k);
        *rootRef = s;
    } else {
        insertNonFull(r, k);
    }
}

// Get predecessor
int getPred(BTreeNode* x) {
    while (!x->leaf)
        x = x->C[x->n];
    return x->keys[x->n - 1];
}

// Get successor
int getSucc(BTreeNode* x) {
    while (!x->leaf)
        x = x->C[0];
    return x->keys[0];
}

void merge(BTreeNode* x, int idx) {

    for (int i = idx + 1; i < x->n; ++i)

    for (int i = idx + 2; i <= x->n; ++i)

// Fill child if less than t-1 keys
void fill(BTreeNode* x, int idx) {
    int t = x->t;
    if (idx > 0 && x->C[idx - 1]->n >= t) {
        BTreeNode* child = x->C[idx];
        BTreeNode* sibling = x->C[idx - 1];
        for (int i = child->n - 1; i >= 0; --i)
            child->keys[i + 1] = child->keys[i];
        if (!child->leaf) {
            for (int i = child->n; i >= 0; --i)
                child->C[i + 1] = child->C[i];
        }
        child->keys[0] = x->keys[idx - 1];
        if (!child->leaf)
            child->C[0] = sibling->C[sibling->n];
        x->keys[idx - 1] = sibling->keys[sibling->n - 1];
        child->n += 1;
        sibling->n -= 1;
    } else if (idx < x->n && x->C[idx + 1]->n >= t) {
        BTreeNode* child = x->C[idx];
        BTreeNode* sibling = x->C[idx + 1];
        child->keys[child->n] = x->keys[idx];
        if (!child->leaf)
            child->C[child->n + 1] = sibling->C[0];
        x->keys[idx] = sibling->keys[0];
        for (int i = 1; i < sibling->n; ++i)
            sibling->keys[i - 1] = sibling->keys[i];
        if (!sibling->leaf) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= sibling->n; ++i)
                sibling->C[i - 1] = sibling->C[i];
        }
        child->n += 1;
        sibling->n -= 1;
    } else {
        if (idx != x->n)
            merge(x, idx);
        else
            merge(x, idx - 1);
    }
}

// Remove key from tree
void removeFromNode(BTreeNode* x, int k) {
    int idx = 0;
    while (idx < x->n && x->keys[idx] < k)
        ++idx;
    if (idx < x->n && x->keys[idx] == k) {
        if (x->leaf) {
            for (int i = idx + 1; i < x->n; ++i)
                x->keys[i - 1] = x->keys[i];
            x->n--;
        } else {
            if (x->C[idx]->n >= x->t) {
                int pred = getPred(x->C[idx]);
                x->keys[idx] = pred;
                removeFromNode(x->C[idx], pred);
            } else if (x->C[idx + 1]->n >= x->t) {
                int succ = getSucc(x->C[idx + 1]);
                x->keys[idx] = succ;
                removeFromNode(x->C[idx + 1], succ);
            } else {
                merge(x, idx);
                removeFromNode(x->C[idx], k);
            }
        }
    } else {
        if (x->leaf)
            return;
        bool flag = (idx == x->n);
        if (x->C[idx]->n < x->t)
            fill(x, idx);
        if (flag && idx > x->n)
            removeFromNode(x->C[idx - 1], k);
        else
            removeFromNode(x->C[idx], k);
    }
}

#include<stdio.h>
#define MAX_SIZE 20
int heap[MAX_SIZE];
int size = 0;
void swap(int*a,int*b){
	int temp = *a;
	*a = *b;
	*b = temp;
}
void heapifyUp(int index){
	while(index>0){
		int parent = (index-1)/2;
		if(heap[index]<heap[parent]){
			swap(&heap[index],&heap[parent]);
			index = parent;
		}else{
			break;
		}
	}
}
void insert(int value){
	heap[size] = value;
	heapifyUp(size);
	size++;
}
void heapifyDown(int index){
	while(1){
		int left = 2*index+1;
		int right = 2*index+2;
		int smallest = index;
		if(left<size && heap[left]<heap[smallest])
			smallest = left;
		if(right<size && heap[right]<heap[smallest])
			smallest = right;
		if(smallest!= index){
			swap(&heap[index],&heap[smallest]);
			index = smallest;
		}else{
			break;
		}
	}
}

void heapifyUp(int index){
	while(index>0){

			index=parent;

	}

    queue[rear++] = vertex;

    return queue[front++];

                visited[i] = 1;

            }

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#define MAX 100
int adj[MAX][MAX];  // Adjacency matrix-style list
int visited[MAX];
int adjCount[MAX];  // Number of adjacent vertices for each node
// Comparison function for qsort
int compare(const void *a, const void *b) {
    return (*(int *)a - *(int *)b);
}
void dfs(int vertex) {
    visited[vertex] = 1;
    printf("%d ", vertex);
    for (int i = 0; i < adjCount[vertex]; i++) {
        int neighbor = adj[vertex][i];
        if (!visited[neighbor]) {
            dfs(neighbor);
        }
    }
}
int main() {
    int vertices, edges;
    scanf("%d %d", &vertices, &edges);
    // Initialize adjacency list and visited array
    for (int i = 0; i < vertices; i++) {
        adjCount[i] = 0;
        visited[i] = 0;
    }
    // Read edges
    for (int i = 0; i < edges; i++) {
        int u, v;
        scanf("%d %d", &u, &v);
        adj[u][adjCount[u]++] = v; // directed edge u → v
    }
    // Sort neighbors to process in increasing order
    for (int i = 0; i < vertices; i++) {
        qsort(adj[i], adjCount[i], sizeof(int), compare);
    }
    int start;
    scanf("%d", &start);
    dfs(start);
    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#define MAX 100

int V, E;
int adj[MAX][MAX];
int disc[MAX], low[MAX], parent[MAX];
int time_dfs, bccCount;

struct Edge {
    int u, v;
} stackEdges[MAX * MAX];

int top = -1;

void pushEdge(int u, int v) {
    stackEdges[++top] = (struct Edge){u, v};
}

void popUntil(int u, int v) {
    while (top >= 0) {
        struct Edge e = stackEdges[top--];
        if ((e.u == u && e.v == v) ||
            (e.u == v && e.v == u))
            break;
    }
}

void BCCUtil(int u) {
    int children = 0;
    disc[u] = low[u] = ++time_dfs;

    for (int v = 0; v < V; v++) {
        if (adj[u][v]) {
            if (disc[v] == -1) {
                children++;
                parent[v] = u;
                pushEdge(u, v);
                BCCUtil(v);

                if (low[v] >= disc[u]) {
                    bccCount++;

                    popUntil(u, v);
                }

                if (low[v] < low[u])
                    low[u] = low[v];
            }
            else if (v != parent[u] && disc[v] < disc[u]) {
                pushEdge(u, v);
                if (disc[v] < low[u])
                    low[u] = disc[v];
            }
        }
    }
}

void findBCCs() {
    for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
        disc[i] = -1;
        parent[i] = -1;
    }

    time_dfs = 0;
    bccCount = 0;
    top = -1;

        if (disc[i] == -1) {
            BCCUtil(i);

            if (top >= 0) {
                bccCount++;
                top = -1;
            }
        }
    }
}

#include<stdio.h>
void swap(int*a,int*b){
	int temp=*a;
	*a=*b;
	*b=temp;
}
int partition(int arr[],int low,int high){
	int pivot=arr[low];
	int i=low;
	int j=high+1;
	while(i<j){
		do{
		i++;
		}while(arr[i]<=pivot);
		do{
		j--;
		}while(arr[j]>pivot);
		if(i<j)
			swap(&arr[i],&arr[j]);
	}
		swap(&arr[low],&arr[j]);
		return j;
	}
	void quicksort(int arr[],int low,int high){
		if(low<high){
			int pi=partition(arr,low,high);
			quicksort(arr,low,pi-1);
			quicksort(arr,pi+1,high);
		}
	}
	int main(){
	int i,n;
		scanf("%d",&n);
		int arr[n];
		for(i=0;i<n;i++){
		scanf("%d",&arr[i]);
		}
		quicksort(arr,0,n-1);
		for(i=0;i<n;i++){
		printf("%d ",arr[i]);
		}
		printf("\n");
		return 0;
	}

void merge(int arr[],int low,int mid,int high)

	int k = low;
while(i<=mid && j<=high)

		temp[k++] = arr[j++];

		merge(arr,low,mid,high);

// Function to find vertex with minimum distance not yet visited
int minDistance(int dist[], int visited[]) {
    int min = INF, min_index = -1;
    for (int v = 0; v < n; v++) {
        if (!visited[v] && dist[v] <= min) {
            min = dist[v];
            min_index = v;
        }
    }
    return min_index;
}
void dijkstra(int src) {

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        dist[i] = INF;
        visited[i] = 0;
    }
    dist[src] = 0;

    for (int count = 0; count < n - 1; count++) {
        int u = minDistance(dist, visited);
        if (u == -1) break; // no more reachable vertices
        visited[u] = 1;
        // Update neighbors
        for (int v = 0; v < n; v++) {
            if (!visited[v] && graph[u][v] != INF &&
                dist[u] != INF &&

                dist[v] = dist[u] + graph[u][v];

        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (dist[i] == INF)
            printf("%d -1\n", i); // unreachable

We earn the profit associated with the job if and only if the job is completed by its deadline. Find the number of jobs done and themaximum profit.


Note:Jobs will be given in the form (Job Id, Deadline, Profit) associated with that Job. The deadline of the job is the time by which the job needs to be completed to earn the profit.


Input Format:

  • The first line contains an integer N representing the number of jobs.
  • The next N lines each contain three space-separated integers: {Job ID, Job Deadline, Job Profit} — representing one job per line.


Output Format

  • Two integers separated by a space:
  • The first integer represents the number of jobs done.The second integer represents the maximum profit obtained.


Constraints:

  • 1≤N≤105
  • 1≤Deadline≤N
  • 1≤Profit≤500

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
// Structure for a Job
typedef struct {
    int id;
    int deadline;
    int profit;
} Job;

// Compare function for sorting jobs in descending order of profit
int compare(const void *a, const void *b) {
    Job *j1 = (Job *)a;
    Job *j2 = (Job *)b;
    return j2->profit - j1->profit;
}

int main() {
    int n;
    scanf("%d", &n);

    Job jobs[n];
    int i;

    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        scanf("%d %d %d", &jobs[i].id, &jobs[i].deadline, &jobs[i].profit);
    }

    // Sort jobs by profit in descending order
    qsort(jobs, n, sizeof(Job), compare);

    // Find maximum deadline
    int maxDeadline = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (jobs[i].deadline > maxDeadline) {
            maxDeadline = jobs[i].deadline;
        }
    }

    // Create slots (all initially free)
    int slot[maxDeadline + 1];
    for (i = 0; i <= maxDeadline; i++) {
        slot[i] = -1;
    }
ID: 25B01A1215 Page No:
Shri Vishnu Engineering College for Women (Autonomous) 2025-2029-IT-A 
    int countJobs = 0, totalProfit = 0;

    // Schedule jobs
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        // Try to schedule in the latest free slot <= deadline
        for (int j = jobs[i].deadline; j > 0; j--) {
            if (slot[j] == -1) {
                slot[j] = jobs[i].id;
                countJobs++;
                totalProfit += jobs[i].profit;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    printf("%d %d\n", countJobs, totalProfit);
    return 0;
}

S.No: 14 Exp. Name: Program to implement Knapsack problem Using Dynamic Programming Date: 2026-10-31
Aim:

You are given n items, each with a specific weight and value. You have a knapsack with a maximum capacity W. Your goal is to select a subset of these items such that the total weight is less than or equal to W, and the total value is as large as possible.


This is the classic 0/1 Knapsack problem, where each item can either be included once or excluded from the knapsack.


Input Format:

  • The first line contains an integer n, representing the number of items to consider for the knapsack.
  • The second line contains n space-separated integers, representing the weights of the items.
  • The third line contains n space-separated integers, representing the values of the items, corresponding to their weights.
  • The fourth line contains an integer W, representing the capacity of the knapsack.


Output Format:

  • Print the maximum profit that can be obtained by selecting items such that their combined weight does not exceed the knapsack capacity.


Note: Refer to the test cases for better understanding.

dynamicKs.c
#include <stdio.h>
// Function to solve 0/1 Knapsack problem
int knapsack(int weights[], int profits[], int n, int m) {
    int M[n + 1][m + 1];
    // Build table dp[][] in bottom up manner
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
            if (i == 0 || j == 0)
                M[i][j] = 0;
            else if (weights[i-1] <= j)
                M[i][j]=(profits[i-1]+M[i-1][j-weights[i-1]]>M[i-1][j])?(profits[i-1]+M[i-1][j-weights[i-1]]):M[i-1][j];
            else
                M[i][j] = M[i - 1][j];
        }
    }
    return M[n][m];
}
int main() {
    int n;
    scanf("%d", &n);
    int weights[n], profits[n];
    // Input: weights
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        scanf("%d", &weights[i]);
    }
    // Input: values
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        scanf("%d", &profits[i]);
    }
    int capacity;
    scanf("%d", &capacity);
    // Solve and print result
    int maxProfit = knapsack(weights, profits, n, capacity);
    printf("%d\n", maxProfit);
    return 0;
}

Aim:

Write a C program to solve the N-Queens problem using backtracking. The goal is to place N queens on an N×N chessboard such that no two queens attack each other. A queen can attack another queen if they share the same row, column, or diagonal. Your program should print the first valid configuration of the board found by placing queens from left to right and top to bottom, using a backtracking approach. The board must be displayed as an N×N matrix where a cell contains 1 if a queen is placed there, and 0 otherwise. If no solution exists for the given value of N, print a message indicating that no solution exists.


Input Format:

  • A single integer N — the number of queens and the size of the chessboard.


Output Format:

  • If a solution exists, print an N×N matrix consisting of 0s and 1s, where 1 represents a queen.
  • If no solution exists, print: "No solution exists for N = <value>".
  • Each row of the matrix should be printed on a new line, with space-separated values.


Note: Refer to the test cases for better understanding.

nqueens.c
#include<stdio.h>
#include<stdbool.h>
#define MAX 20
int board[MAX][MAX],N;
void printBoard(){
	for(int i=0;i<N;i++)
		{
			for(int j=0;j<N;j++)
				printf("%d ",board[i][j]);
			printf("\n");
		}
}
bool issafe(int row,int col){
	for(int i=0;i<row;i++)
		if(board[i][col])return false;
	for(int i=row,j=col;i>=0&&j>=0;i--,j--)
		if(board[i][j])return false;
	for(int i=row,j=col;i>=0&&j<N;i--,j++)
		if(board[i][j]) return false;
	return true;
}
bool solveNQueens(int row){
	if(row>=N)return true;
	for(int col=0;col<N;col++){
		if(issafe(row,col)){
			board[row][col]=1;
			if(solveNQueens(row+1))
				return true;
			board[row][col]=0;
		}
	}
	return false;
}
int main(){
	scanf("%d",&N);
	if(solveNQueens(0))
		printBoard();
	else 
		printf("No solution exists for N = %d\n",N);
	return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
int n;
int values[20], weights[20]; 
int W;
int maxProfit = 0;
void knapsack(int i, int currentWeight, int currentValue) {
	if (i == n) {
		if (currentValue > maxProfit)
			maxProfit = currentValue;
		return;
	}
	if (currentWeight + weights[i] <= W)
		knapsack(i + 1, currentWeight + weights[i], currentValue + values[i]);
	knapsack(i + 1, currentWeight, currentValue);
}
int main() {
	scanf("%d", &n);
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
		scanf("%d %d", &values[i], &weights[i]);
	scanf("%d", &W);
	knapsack(0, 0, 0);
	printf("%d\n", maxProfit);
	return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#define INF 1000000000000000LL

int main() {
    int n;
    scanf("%d", &n);

    int cost[20][20];

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            scanf("%d", &cost[i][j]);
        }
    }

    if (n == 1) {
        printf("0\n");
        return 0;
    }

    int total = 1 << n;

    long long **dp = malloc(total * sizeof(long long *));

    for (int i = 0; i < total; i++) {
        dp[i] = malloc(n * sizeof(long long));

        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            dp[i][j] = INF;
        }
    }

    dp[1][0] = 0;

    for (int mask = 1; mask < total; mask++) {
        for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) {

            if (dp[mask][u] == INF)
                continue;

            if (!(mask & (1 << u)))
                continue;
ID: 25B01A1215 Page No:
Shri Vishnu Engineering College for Women (Autonomous) 2025-2029-IT-A 
            for (int v = 0; v < n; v++) {

                if (!(mask & (1 << v)) && cost[u][v] != -1) {

                    int newMask = mask | (1 << v);

                    long long newCost =
                        dp[mask][u] + cost[u][v];

                    if (newCost < dp[newMask][v]) {
                        dp[newMask][v] = newCost;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    long long ans = INF;
    int fullMask = total - 1;

    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {

        if (dp[fullMask][i] != INF && cost[i][0] != -1) {

            long long value = dp[fullMask][i] + cost[i][0];

            if (value < ans)
                ans = value;
        }
    }

    if (ans == INF)
        printf("-1\n");
    else
        printf("%lld\n", ans);

    for (int i = 0; i < total; i++)
        free(dp[i]);

    free(dp);

    return 0;
}
